verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a data-pipeline product, but nothing in the evidence documents it. Reverse ETL and warehouse syncs are described only as one-off "sync data" capabilities, with no schedule, cron, or recurrence settings, and "continuously capture and sync consent preferences" describes streaming behavior, not user-defined schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
